title: Heavenly Argentine Marzipan Mousse
description: A fermented, velvety dessert that combines sweet marzipan with citrusy yogurt, shaped into delicate nigiri-style bites for a quick, ovo-vegetarian treat.
instructions: Place chopped marzipan, lemon zest, and ground grape seeds in a bowl and mix until evenly distributed.
Add Greek yogurt and honey and stir until the mixture becomes smooth and creamy.
Fold in chopped mint leaves and a pinch of salt, then chill the mixture in the refrigerator for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
While the mixture chills, toast almond slivers on a dry pan until golden brown, then set aside to cool.
Remove the mousse from the fridge and use a small spoon or melon baller to scoop it into nigiri-sized portions.
Place each portion on a chilled plate and spread a thin layer of toasted almond slivers on top for crunch.
Arrange the bites in a single layer and refrigerate again for 5 minutes to set the shape.
Serve immediately with a drizzle of honey on the side and a sprig of mint for garnish.
